title: Write: Direct Contact and Coil
story: Welcome to logic programming! Place an XIC contact and an OTE coil onto the ladder rung so pressing START turns on the LAMP.
concept: Direct control: An XIC contact in series with an OTE coil replicates a simple switch-lamp circuit in software.

learn.title: Software Ladder Logic
learn.text: Instead of physical wires, place XIC and OTE instructions on the rung.

hints: Select XIC from the tray and place it in the rung condition slot.
Assign the START tag to the XIC contact.
Select OTE from the tray, place it in the output slot, and assign LAMP.
